title: Malicious SHA-256 file hash af3e4ef0c187… (OffSeq Mirage)
description: A malicious file identified by the SHA-256 hash af3e4ef0c18704fc45dc2276cae6d0010449778066c67c93c1891f62fcd3a54d was observed by OffSeq Mirage honeypot sensors on 2026-11-14. This file was detected three times during attacker activity involving the T1105 technique (Ingress Tool Transfer) from attacker infrastructure located in the Netherlands. The hash corresponds to a malicious payload that could be a dropper, web shell, miner, or post-exploitation tool. Organizations are advised to match this hash against files in their environments and security tools to detect potential compromise.
